reference.source_state: working-tree snapshot after compact certified KNN and lazy independent host storage
reference.purpose: Immutable immediate baseline before the every-retained-run 2x requirement

target_policy: Every retained timed pair for each named operation must reach the target ratio of sklearn-default time to current time on every dataset. A single paired-round miss fails the gate even when every median passes. The existing warmup count and interleaved sample order are unchanged. First-call compilation observations remain separate, and are not retained samples. Fit alone is reported separately; fresh fit_query includes preparation. Paired-round counts compare corresponding interleaved rounds; halves divide retained rounds chronologically (the first half takes an odd extra round). These ratios and counts are measurements, not confidence bounds.
